notes.title: December 2018 Patch
notes.content:
Hello friends! 

I'm deeply sorry I couldn't update the game before... I finally had some time and courage to open up the game and make some well deserved fixes. 

[b]So, here a short description of the update content: [/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed performance issues
[*] Fixed an issue with long run and random abilities
[*] Fixed issues with some Character powers
[*] Balanced "Priest" Scenario
[/list]

This is all thanks to your valuable feedback. I have a deep gratitude to people taking time to make positive and constructive to the game forum.
The main change of the version is the balance made to the "Priest" scenario. After receiving several complaints about the difficulty of the scenario, I've decided to make some adjustements to make it easier while keeping the interest of it. So now, you won't encounter enemies in this run, instead you will be face to face with the "Legendary Places", and that's still quite of a challenge!
Hoping you'll all have fun with it,
In peace, 
Jérôme

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25419696/21b1dc1dabf5de67e973a1b1ed5c5a22ff6d7b67.jpg[/img]

notes.title: "Revolution Edition", the last content update, is out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25419696/f590cda15d4e3b65476683debb55e239c3e01d66.jpg[/img]

[b]"Revolution Edition"[/b] is the last content update for Frost. As previous ones, it's released for free and includes numerous changes:

[list]
[*][b] A new and very personal scenario[/b], "the Author"
[*][b] A new mechanic[/b], based on a new type of Fatigue cards: Terror cards. If you get three of those, you lose!
[*] Modifications to existing cards
[*] Bug fixes and minor cosmetic changes
[/list]



This update is going to be the last one, but hopefully it won't be the end for Frost! Stay tuned for coming news about it!

It's been a year since I released the game, and it was quite a journey! Many thanks to everyone who played, enjoyed, commented on and helped in making the game. This project has meant so much to me. With love, Jérôme

notes.title: Fresh Start & Companions - new free extension is out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25419696/14ac069cca7c369a69f2342f0319500c60d099e0.jpg[/img]

[b]Fresh Start & Companions extension is out![/b] Discover the new Pets cards, the new Scenario and the Custom Game mode!

Features...
[list]
[*] [b]Custom Games![/b] Standard and Hard modes have been taken out so you can craft your own set of difficulty settings
[*] [b]New Scenario:[/b] The Guidance. Gather animal pets and lead them to the Refuge
[*] [b]Pets![/b] You can find them as a Resource but they offer valuable options
[*] New Survivors portraits
[*] New zooming options for people with sight troubles and people with small devices
[*] Graphic quality options have been cleaned and set up. "Simplest" setting should work fine on older computers.
[*] Cleaner and more beautiful UI VFX
[*] Several fix for issues brought up by the community, including Achievements fix
[/list]

To celebrate, the game will be 25% off for a week! Tell your friends :)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25419696/4cae5fe117f1a10b64eb5402d68bb8ccb975e85a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: "Beyond the Wall" - Content update #2 is out!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25419696/5882edf9baf4f23506de2530d1cd508256ebeabb.jpg[/img]

"Beyond the Wall" is out! 

This new content update features...
[list]
[*] The Skeptic Scenario: is the Refuge an illusion? Try to find and climb the Wall, and lead your people beyond it.
[*] The Recruiter Scenario: people from beyond the Wall need workforce. Your work is to find some of those primitive survivors to bring them back.
[*] "Tactics", a new  mechanic that allows you to change the current Event
[*] "Teach", this ability will add a random ability to one your Survivor
[*] 5 new cards based
[*] And a brand new menu, Collection, where you can check the cards you unlocked! 
[/list]
